vb_textbox.text: Start by choosing one colour, if you get lots of mushrooms (I found it was up to about 8 or 9) then stick with that colour. There are 4 coloured gnomes so choose one colour out of each pair. When the number of mushrooms goes down to low numbers (1,2,0) try changing the colour. Sometimes both gnomes no matter the colour will give you a low number so it can end up being a bit of a switch till it changes again and then choose a colour and stick with it. I found that out of the 2 pairs if the number started going down on one you only needed to change one colour and not both so if you started with purple and brown and purple went down - change to green but stick with brown. Good luck!
